Spatial audio
Off, fixed, and head-tracked output through Android Spatializer
Uses Android hidden Spatializer and a root UHID head tracker. Grant root to P.O.D.S. in KernelSU/Magisk, then keep AirPods audio active and the control connection synchronized for head-tracked mode.
